_about: Office (service) and club names AICAD should recognise, beyond canonical names and PlaceResolver's built-in list. Each entry states its basis: 'official' = the name as used on ARUCAD's own pages (indexed corpus); 'product' = the wording this application already uses; 'inflection' = a grammatical case of an existing official or product name (Russian nouns change form: 'студенческий офис' → 'студенческого офиса'), which whole-phrase matching cannot otherwise reach. Diacritic-free Turkish needs no entries: matching is on folded text. Seeded with php artisan db:seed --class=AiCampusAliasSeeder; editable afterwards in Admin → AICAD aliases.
